image_ref.description: Mesh-scoped reference to the source image. Accepts 'sandbox://<path>' for files staged in the mesh scratch space or 'data:image/<png|jpeg|webp>;base64,<...>' for inline payloads. Raw filesystem paths are rejected by the runner.

prompt.description: Optional instruction shaping the description (e.g. 'list UI elements', 'caption for alt-text'). Defaults to a neutral dense caption when omitted.

max_tokens.description: Soft cap on description length in model tokens. Runner clamps to lab policy if exceeded.

detail.description: Granularity hint. 'low' = one-line caption; 'auto' = dense paragraph; 'high' = multi-section structured description including layout and OCR-visible text hints.

description.description: Free-text description produced by GLM-4.6V. No bounding boxes; for grounded localization the planner should chain to image-ground-bbox.

model.description: Concrete model id that produced the description. Stable enough to cite in receipts.

tokens_used.description: Tokens consumed by the underlying VLM call. Free at the mesh boundary; surfaced for capacity-planning telemetry.

summary: Dense natural-language description of a sandbox-scoped image via the self-hosted GLM-4.6V vision-language model.
